generated.description: A large Renaissance-themed build pack by TheDreamSanctuary, a collection of structures rather than a single building. It is built mainly from oak, dark oak and spruce wood with stone bricks, cobblestone walls, and white and black wool accents, with emerald blocks and ore-block details. It spans about 181 by 27 by 119 blocks, with tall towers and houses, and includes functional block entities such as chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a mob spawner, a record player and signs.
